notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Conception II: Children of the Seven Stars, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Conception II: Children of the Seven Stars is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

It's time for classmating!

Monsters have invaded the world of Aterra, and only a few special individuals, imbued with the power of the Star God, are equipped to fight it. Combine your Star power to make magical Star Children to boost up your forces in battle!

*Offer ends August 22 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Conception II Bringing Date-O-Dungeoning To PC
notes.notes:
How is babby formed? Well, little Timmy, when a mummy Disciple and a daddy Disciple are imbued with the power of the Star God and need to create Star Children to save the world, they take a special matryoshka doll and… this is awfully complex. Maybe it’s best you wait a few weeks for Conception II: Children of the Seven Stars [Steam page] to come along. After a few years on pocket computers, Spike Chunsoft’s weird and trashy dating sim-cum-dungeon crawler is coming to PC. It will explain all about babby.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Price and Bonus Items
notes.notes:
[i]Conception II: Children of the Seven Stars[/i] arrives on Steam on August 16 for 19.99 USD.
First week purchases include a 20% discount and mini-OST.
(*Mini-OST only available during first week after launch.)

The Steam port supports trading cards and offers 8 cards, 7 backgrounds and 10 emotions.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717505/70bb3a0f10b77df1954afe7df93e9e0b3345b978.png[/img]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/504270]10-song mini-soundtrack details[/url]: 
Composed by Masato Koda
Tracks 1-5, 10: Lyrics by Marie
Tracks 1-5, 10: Performed by Phantasmagoric

Contains MP3 files. 

[b]Complete Track Listing[/b] 
01.	Spicate ~7-Colored Celestial Sphere~
02.	Harvest Code
03.	A Breath’s Distance
04.	Congratulations!
05.	Dungeon Battle 1 (First Half)
06.	Melody of Footsteps (Fuuko’s Theme)
07.	Monochromatic Color (Torii’s Theme)
08.	A Piece of Courage (Narika’s Theme)
09.	The Heart’s Opposite Bank (Serina’s Theme)
10.	Eternally Holding Your Hand
